address: Rue de la Chapelle, Le Praz, Courchevel, 73120, France
bio: This pleasant establishment stands slightly back from the road in the up-market ski resort of Courchevel. In a friendly alpine bistro vibe, you will sample hearty, painstakingly crafted dishes, in tune with today’s palates: carpaccio of scallops, lovage oil and citrus fruit; open raviole of veal and poached egg. Insightful wine-food pairings and a terrace overlooking the lake in fine weather....
